intro.en: Western Corsican appellation with a strong Sciaccarellu identity.
intro.zh: Corsica 西部产区，Sciaccarellu 身份突出。

intro.en: Alsace is a vineyard corridor east of the Vosges; grape, site and sweetness are separate dimensions.
intro.zh: Alsace 为 Vosges 东侧葡萄园带；品种、地块、甜度须分别理解。

intro.en: Protected Gascon grape-spirit identity with three principal terroirs.
intro.zh: 受保护 Gascon 葡萄蒸馏酒身份，有三大风土区。

intro.en: A Massif Central regional grouping containing distinct Auvergne and Saint-Pourçain identities.
intro.zh: Massif Central 区域组合，含不同 Auvergne、Saint-Pourçain 身份。

intro.en: Provençal appellation particularly associated with Mourvèdre reds and rosés.
intro.zh: Provence 产区，尤其关联 Mourvèdre 红、桃红。

intro.en: Foothill red, rosé and white wines, with Raffiat de Moncade a white distinction.
intro.zh: 山麓红、桃红、白酒，Raffiat de Moncade 为白酒特色。

intro.en: Gamay-focused region south of Mâcon, encompassing early-drinking and ageworthy cru wines.
intro.zh: Mâcon 以南以 Gamay 为核心，兼早饮及可陈年 cru 酒。

intro.en: Small independent appellation on the hills above Nice.
intro.zh: Nice 上方丘陵的小型独立产区。

intro.en: Neighbouring southwestern appellations with Bordeaux-family grapes and independent identities.
intro.zh: 西南相邻产区，使用 Bordeaux 系品种但身份独立。

intro.en: An Atlantic wine region of separate appellations, red blends, dry whites, sweet wines and multiple estate-classification systems.
intro.zh: 大西洋葡萄酒区，含独立产区、红调配、干白、甜酒及多种酒庄分级。

intro.en: A hierarchy of regional, village and vineyard names connects grape varieties to specific sites.
intro.zh: 大区、村庄及葡萄园名称层级，将品种与特定地块相连。

intro.en: Regional Bourgogne white appellation dedicated to Aligoté.
intro.zh: 专门对应 Aligoté 的 Bourgogne 大区白酒产区。

intro.en: Ain foothill vineyards between Jura and Savoie, with distinct still and sparkling traditions.
intro.zh: Ain 山麓葡萄园，介 Jura、Savoie 之间，静止起泡传统各异。

intro.en: A Lot-valley red appellation centred on Malbec.
intro.zh: 以 Malbec 为核心的 Lot 河谷红酒产区。

intro.en: A group of inland Loire appellations, particularly known for Sauvignon Blanc, with important red and other white identities.
intro.zh: Loire 内陆产区群，以 Sauvignon Blanc 突出，也有重要红酒及其他白酒。

intro.en: Northeastern French sparkling-wine appellation based on cool-climate grapes, blending and bottle fermentation; neighbouring still-wine AOCs are separate.
intro.zh: 法国东北部起泡酒产区，以凉爽气候葡萄、调配和瓶中发酵为核心；相邻静止酒 AOC 另列。

intro.en: Charentais viticultural territory containing Cognac spirit production and separate wine identities; this profile is geographic, not a single wine AOC.
intro.zh: Charentes 栽培区域，含 Cognac 蒸馏酒及独立葡萄酒身份；本页为地理区域，不是单一葡萄酒 AOC。

intro.en: A mountainous Mediterranean island with distinct coastal, inland and local-variety identities.
intro.zh: 多山地中海岛屿，海岸、内陆及地方品种身份各异。

intro.en: A revived vineyard area around the Gier valley, important for rare local grapes.
intro.zh: Gier 谷地周边复兴葡萄园区，对稀有地方品种重要。

intro.en: Small wine appellation west and southwest of Lyon.
intro.zh: Lyon 西、西南的小型葡萄酒产区。

intro.en: A major Gascon wine IGP, particularly associated with aromatic whites.
intro.zh: Gascon 重要葡萄酒 IGP，尤其关联芳香白酒。

intro.en: A Garonne-side appellation with local Abouriou alongside Bordeaux-family grapes.
intro.zh: Garonne 两岸产区，地方 Abouriou 与 Bordeaux 系品种并存。

intro.en: A red and rosé appellation distinguished by Négrette.
intro.zh: 以 Négrette 为特色的红、桃红产区。

intro.en: A Tarn-region appellation with unusually diverse local grapes and wine styles.
intro.zh: Tarn 地区产区，地方品种及风格多样。

intro.en: Alpine departmental wine IGP with an important Mollard heritage.
intro.zh: 阿尔卑斯省级葡萄酒 IGP，Mollard 传统重要。

intro.en: French Basque foothill appellation producing red, rosé and white wines.
intro.zh: 法国 Basque 山麓产区，产红、桃红、白。

intro.en: Regional vineyard geography containing Isère IGP and distinct local sectors.
intro.zh: 地区葡萄园地理，含 Isère IGP 及不同地方片区。

intro.en: Jura combines local grapes, topped-up whites and sous-voile styles; wider Franche-Comté heritage extends beyond these AOCs.
intro.zh: Jura 结合地方品种、添桶白酒与酒膜风格；更广 Franche-Comté 传统不限于这些 AOC。

intro.en: Pyrenean-foothill dry and sweet whites retaining strong acidity.
intro.zh: 比利牛斯山麓干、甜白酒，保留鲜明酸度。

intro.en: A Mediterranean wine region containing many AOCs and IGPs; broad regional geography differs from Languedoc AOC.
intro.zh: 地中海酒区，含多个 AOC、IGP；广义地区与 Languedoc AOC 不同。

intro.en: A west–east sequence of independent wine regions along the Loire and its tributaries, not one appellation.
intro.zh: 沿 Loire 与支流由西向东的一系列独立酒区，不是单一法定产区。

intro.en: Northeastern regional umbrella containing distinct Toul, Moselle and Meuse wine identities.
intro.zh: 东北区域总称，包含 Toul、Moselle、Meuse 不同酒区身份。

intro.en: A southwestern red appellation strongly associated with Tannat.
intro.zh: 与 Tannat 密切相关的西南红酒产区。

intro.en: An Aveyron red and rosé appellation associated with Fer, locally Mansois.
intro.zh: Aveyron 红、桃红产区，关联 Fer，当地称 Mansois。

intro.en: Corsican vin doux naturel appellation based on Muscat.
intro.zh: 以 Muscat 为基础的 Corsica vin doux naturel 产区。

intro.en: Dry and sweet whites sharing territory with Madiran red wines.
intro.zh: 与 Madiran 红酒共享地域的干、甜白酒。

intro.en: Small Provençal appellation near Aix-en-Provence with diverse traditional grapes.
intro.zh: Aix-en-Provence 附近小型 Provence 产区，有多样传统品种。

intro.en: Northern Corsican appellation associated with Niellucciu and limestone-rich sites.
intro.zh: Corsica 北部产区，关联 Niellucciu 与富石灰质地块。

intro.en: Broad southern French wine IGP with a strong varietal-wine identity.
intro.zh: 法国南部广域葡萄酒 IGP，品种酒身份突出。

intro.en: Mediterranean southeastern France, with several independent AOCs and red, white and rosé traditions.
intro.zh: 法国东南地中海区域，含多个独立 AOC 及红、白、桃红传统。

intro.en: A north–south wine corridor with many independent AOCs; Rhône Valley geography is broader than Côtes du Rhône AOC.
intro.zh: 南北向葡萄酒走廊，含许多独立 AOC；Rhône Valley 地理范围广于 Côtes du Rhône AOC。

intro.en: A southern French region combining dry wines and fortified vins doux naturels beside the Mediterranean and Pyrenees.
intro.zh: 地中海与比利牛斯旁法国南部地区，兼有干酒及强化 vins doux naturels。

intro.en: Gascon appellation combining red, rosé and white wines with active local-grape conservation.
intro.zh: Gascon 产区，兼红、桃红、白及活跃地方品种保育。

intro.en: An Alpine mosaic of lake shores, valleys and steep slopes with sharply local grape identities.
intro.zh: 阿尔卑斯湖岸、谷地与陡坡组合，品种身份具有鲜明地方性。

intro.en: Small Rhône-crossing appellation for still and sparkling white wines.
intro.zh: 横跨 Rhône 的小产区，酿静止及起泡白。

intro.en: A Landes-area appellation whose Baroque-based whites distinguish it locally.
intro.zh: Landes 一带产区，Baroque 白酒具有地方特色。

intro.en: Adriatic central Italian region between mountains and coast, combining Montepulciano reds, Cerasuolo rosé and distinct white-grape traditions.
intro.zh: 亚得里亚海与山地间的意大利中部大区，融合 Montepulciano 红酒、Cerasuolo 桃红及不同白葡萄传统。

intro.en: Northern Basilicata Aglianico DOC, including still and red sparkling wines, separate from the Superiore DOCG.
intro.zh: Basilicata 北部 Aglianico DOC，含静止与红起泡，与 Superiore DOCG 分开。

intro.en: Still-red Aglianico DOCG with lower yields and longer compulsory maturation than the neighbouring DOC category.
intro.zh: 静止红 Aglianico DOCG，产量更低，法定熟成长于相邻 DOC 类别。

intro.en: Vintage traditional-method sparkling PDO, white and rosé.
intro.zh: 标示年份的传统法起泡 PDO，含白及桃红。

intro.en: Autonomous Bolzano province: Alpine valleys, diverse elevations and both local and international grapes.
intro.zh: Bolzano 自治省：阿尔卑斯谷地、多样海拔及本地和国际品种。

intro.en: Concentrated dry-style red from dried Valpolicella grapes.
intro.zh: 由 Valpolicella 风干葡萄酿成的浓缩干型风格红酒。

intro.en: Glera-led sparkling DOCG of the Asolo hills and Montello in Treviso.
intro.zh: Treviso 的 Asolo 丘陵及 Montello、以 Glera 为主的起泡 DOCG。

intro.en: Aromatic Piemonte PDO encompassing Asti spumante, Moscato d’Asti and late-harvest wine.
intro.zh: 涵盖 Asti 起泡、Moscato d’Asti 及晚采酒的 Piemonte 芳香 PDO。

intro.en: Asprinio-based white and sparkling DOC across the Aversa plain, including the historic alberata training tradition.
intro.zh: Aversa 平原以 Asprinio 为主的白及起泡 DOC，包含历史 alberata 树附式栽培传统。

intro.en: Langhe Nebbiolo dry-red PDO distinct from Barolo.
intro.zh: 与 Barolo 独立的 Langhe Nebbiolo 干红 PDO。

intro.en: Dry red PDO of the Asti and Alessandria hills.
intro.zh: Asti 与 Alessandria 丘陵干红 PDO。

intro.en: Lake Garda’s eastern-shore red and Chiaretto rosé denomination.
intro.zh: Garda 湖东岸红酒及 Chiaretto 桃红产区。

intro.en: Langhe dry-red PDO made from Nebbiolo.
intro.zh: 以 Nebbiolo 酿造的 Langhe 干红 PDO。

intro.en: Southern region whose vineyards span Vulture’s Aglianico, warmer Matera, inland Alta Val d’Agri and heritage-grape recovery around Pollino.
intro.zh: 南部大区，涵盖 Vulture Aglianico、较暖 Matera、内陆 Alta Val d’Agri 及 Pollino 传统葡萄保育。

intro.en: Campobasso DOC with distinct red/rosé and white blends.
intro.zh: Campobasso DOC，红桃红与白酒有不同配比。

intro.en: Coastal Tuscan denomination centred on Castagneto Carducci, with international red grapes and a flexible white blend.
intro.zh: 托斯卡纳沿海以 Castagneto Carducci 为中心的产区，以国际红葡萄及灵活白酒配方见长。

intro.en: Precisely delimited Cabernet-led red denomination within Castagneto Carducci, distinct from Bolgheri DOC.
intro.zh: Castagneto Carducci 内精确划界、Cabernet 主导的红酒产区，与 Bolgheri DOC 独立。

intro.en: Brachetto d’Acqui and Acqui are alternative names of one DOCG.
intro.zh: Brachetto d’Acqui 与 Acqui 是同一 DOCG 的两种名称。

intro.en: Vicenza foothill DOC particularly associated with Vespaiola, as dry Vespaiolo and sweet Torcolato.
intro.zh: Vicenza 山麓 DOC，尤其关联 Vespaiola，酿干型 Vespaiolo、甜型 Torcolato。

intro.en: Long-aged Sangiovese from the municipality of Montalcino; Brunello is a local grape name.
intro.zh: Montalcino 市镇的长陈年 Sangiovese；Brunello 是地方葡萄名称。

intro.en: Calabria links the Gaglioppo tradition of Cirò, late-ripening inland red varieties and the aromatic passito of Bianco. Modern genetic research is essential where historical names have overlapped.
intro.zh: Calabria 包括 Cirò 的 Gaglioppo、内陆晚熟红葡萄及 Bianco 芳香风干酒；历史名称多有交叠，须结合现代遗传研究。

intro.en: Tyrrhenian region combining inland Irpinia and Sannio, volcanic Naples, islands, Caserta and the Amalfi coast. Local cultivar identities are fundamental.
intro.zh: 第勒尼安大区，兼有 Irpinia、Sannio 内陆，Napoli 火山区、岛屿、Caserta、Amalfi 海岸，地方品种精确身份至关重要。

intro.en: Maritime volcanic DOC west of Naples, closely associated with Falanghina Flegrea and Piedirosso.
intro.zh: Napoli 西部海洋影响火山 DOC，紧密关联 Falanghina Flegrea 与 Piedirosso。

intro.en: Broad northern Piemonte DOC with red, rosé, white and sparkling categories.
intro.zh: Piemonte 北部较广 DOC，含红、桃红、白及起泡类别。

intro.en: Sweet late-harvest white from the Frascati area, with its own DOCG identity.
intro.zh: Frascati 一带晚收甜白，具有独立 DOCG 身份。

intro.en: Island-wide Cannonau DOC with a more restricted Classico zone and three named subzones.
intro.zh: 覆盖全岛的 Cannonau DOC，另设较小 Classico 区及三个子区。

intro.en: Mountain-foot Nebbiolo PDO at the Aosta Valley border.
intro.zh: Aosta Valley 边界山前 Nebbiolo PDO。

intro.en: Southwestern Sardegna’s Carignano DOC, with specific bush-vine and maturation requirements for Superiore.
intro.zh: Sardegna 西南部 Carignano DOC，Superiore 有具体灌木藤及熟化要求。

intro.en: Historic Tuscan red blending Sangiovese with a required Cabernet component, centred on Carmignano and Poggio a Caiano.
intro.zh: 历史托斯卡纳红酒，将 Sangiovese 与必需 Cabernet 组分结合，以 Carmignano、Poggio a Caiano 为中心。

intro.en: Border limestone plateau denomination around Trieste and Gorizia, associated with Vitovska, Malvasia Istriana and Terrano.
intro.zh: Trieste、Gorizia 边境石灰岩台地产区，与 Vitovska、Malvasia Istriana、Terrano 相关。

intro.en: Independent DOCG registered in 2025, succeeding the former Montepulciano d’Abruzzo Casauria subzone.
intro.zh: 2025 登记独立 DOCG，承接原 Montepulciano d’Abruzzo Casauria 子区。

name: Castel del Monte Bombino Nero DOCG

intro.en: A distinct denomination of the calcareous Murgia landscape.
intro.zh: 石灰质 Murgia 地区的独立法定产区。

intro.en: A distinct denomination of the calcareous Murgia landscape.
intro.zh: 石灰质 Murgia 地区的独立法定产区。

name: Castel del Monte Nero di Troia Riserva DOCG
aliases: Castel del Monte Nero di Troia Riserva

intro.en: A distinct denomination of the calcareous Murgia landscape.
intro.zh: 石灰质 Murgia 地区的独立法定产区。

name: Castel del Monte Rosso Riserva DOCG

intro.en: A distinct denomination of the calcareous Murgia landscape.
intro.zh: 石灰质 Murgia 地区的独立法定产区。

intro.en: Verdicchio from the Esino hill system, extending from maritime-influenced slopes toward the pre-Apennines.
intro.zh: Esino 丘陵体系的 Verdicchio，从受海洋影响的坡地延向亚平宁山麓。

intro.en: Independent Montepulciano-based Abruzzo rosé DOC.
intro.zh: 以 Montepulciano 为主的独立 Abruzzo 桃红 DOC。

intro.en: A southeastern Sicilian red combining Nero d’Avola structure with Frappato perfume.
intro.zh: Sicilia 东南部红酒，结合 Nero d’Avola 结构与 Frappato 香气。

intro.en: Lazio’s Cesanese red DOCG in the Ernici foothills and upper Sacco valley, also labelled Piglio.
intro.zh: Ernici 山麓及 Sacco 河上游的 Cesanese 红酒 DOCG，亦可标 Piglio。

intro.en: Extensive Tuscan Sangiovese denomination, legally separate from Chianti Classico; the 2026 amendment adds rosé and revises red composition.
intro.zh: 广域托斯卡纳 Sangiovese 产区，与 Chianti Classico 法律上独立；2026修订新增桃红并调整红酒配方。

intro.en: Hill-country Sangiovese between Florence and Siena, with Annata, Riserva and Gran Selezione tiers.
intro.zh: Florence 与 Siena 之间的丘陵 Sangiovese 产区，分 Annata、Riserva、Gran Selezione。

intro.en: Eastern Ligurian coastal PDO for dry white and sweet dried-grape Sciacchetrà.
intro.zh: Liguria 东部海岸干白及风干甜酒 Sciacchetrà PDO。

intro.en: A separate red DOCG recognised in 2025, restricted to Cirò and Cirò Marina.
intro.zh: 2025 年认可的独立红酒 DOCG，仅限 Cirò 与 Cirò Marina。

intro.en: Calabria’s historic Ionian DOC for red, rosato and white; distinct from Cirò Classico DOCG established in 2025.
intro.zh: Calabria 历史悠久的爱奥尼亚海岸 DOC，涵盖红、桃红、白酒；与 2025 年设立的 Cirò Classico DOCG 区分。

intro.en: Cross-border Liguria–Toscana white-and-red PDO.
intro.zh: 跨 Liguria 与 Toscana 的红白酒 PDO。

name: Colli di Scandiano e di Canossa DOC
aliases: Colli di Scandiano e di Canossa

intro.en: Reggio Emilia hill DOC with distinctive whites and several separate Lambrusco expressions.
intro.zh: Reggio Emilia 丘陵 DOC，拥有特色白酒及若干独立 Lambrusco 表达。

name: Colli Orientali del Friuli Picolit DOCG

intro.en: Sweet Picolit-led DOCG from the eastern Friuli hills, with a separately delimited Cialla subzone.
intro.zh: Friuli 东部丘陵以 Picolit 为主的甜酒 DOCG，含独立划定 Cialla 子区。

intro.en: Multi-style Tortona PDO, not a synonym for Timorasso.
intro.zh: 多风格 Tortona PDO，并非 Timorasso 同义词。

intro.en: Teramo hill DOCG, with the current name order established in 2023.
intro.zh: Teramo 丘陵 DOCG，2023 年确立当前词序。

intro.en: Gorizia border hills, noted for dry whites and the local marl-sandstone sequence called ponca.
intro.zh: Gorizia 边境丘陵，以干白及本地称 ponca 的泥灰岩—砂岩层著称。

intro.en: Historic Treviso hillside origin for Glera-led Prosecco Superiore, with Rive and Cartizze distinctions.
intro.zh: Treviso 历史丘陵 Glera 主导 Prosecco Superiore 产地，含 Rive、Cartizze 区分。

intro.en: Lepini foothill denomination giving prominent roles to Bellone and Nero Buono.
intro.zh: Lepini 山麓产区，Bellone 与 Nero Buono 地位突出。

intro.en: Salerno coastal DOC with Furore, Ravello and Tramonti subzones and a remarkable surviving local grape heritage.
intro.zh: Salerno 海岸 DOC，含 Furore、Ravello、Tramonti 子区，并保留重要地方葡萄遗产。

intro.en: Dry Dolcetto DOCG in the southern Langhe.
intro.zh: 南部 Langhe 的 Dolcetto 干红 DOCG。

intro.en: Western Ligurian dry red based on Rossese.
intro.zh: Liguria 西部 Rossese 主导干红。

intro.en: Northern region spanning Emilian plains and foothills, Romagna hills and the Adriatic coast.
intro.zh: 北部大区，跨 Emilia 平原山麓、Romagna 丘陵及亚得里亚海岸。

intro.en: Erbaluce-based Canavese PDO covering dry, sparkling and passito styles.
intro.zh: Canavese 的 Erbaluce PDO，含干型、起泡及 passito。

intro.en: A delimited volcanic-slope DOC with Carricante whites, Nerello-led reds/rosato and traditional-method sparkling wines.
intro.zh: 火山坡地划定 DOC，涵盖 Carricante 白酒、Nerello 主体红／桃红及传统法起泡酒。

intro.en: Benevento white-wine DOC spanning dry, sparkling and concentrated late-harvest styles.
intro.zh: Benevento 白酒 DOC，涵盖干型、起泡与浓缩晚收风格。

intro.en: Fiano-centred Irpinia DOCG, with still wines and traditional-method sparkling categories approved in 2025.
intro.zh: 以 Fiano 为核心的 Irpinia DOCG，含静止酒及 2025 年批准的传统法起泡类型。

intro.en: Traditional-method sparkling PDO south of Lake Iseo.
intro.zh: Iseo 湖以南传统法起泡 PDO。

intro.en: Historic Frascati denomination encompassing still whites of several sweetness levels and sparkling wine.
intro.zh: 历史 Frascati 产区，包含不同甜度静态白酒及起泡酒。

intro.en: Dry white and Riserva from the volcanic Alban Hills, built on two Malvasias.
intro.zh: Alban 火山丘陵干白及 Riserva，以两种 Malvasia 为主体。

intro.en: Asti red DOC with still, Superiore, frizzante and spumante categories.
intro.zh: Asti 红酒 DOC，含静止、Superiore、微起泡及起泡类别。

intro.en: Eastern Udine hill DOC combining indigenous whites, distinctive local reds and international varieties.
intro.zh: Udine 东部丘陵 DOC，结合本土白品种、独特本地红品种及国际品种。

intro.en: Friulian plain DOC associated with extensive gravelly alluvial deposits.
intro.zh: 与广泛砾石冲积物相连的 Friuli 平原 DOC。

intro.en: Border region spanning Adriatic, Karst, eastern hills and alluvial plains, with distinct local grapes and denominations.
intro.zh: 边境大区，跨亚得里亚海、喀斯特、东部丘陵及冲积平原，品种与法定产区各异。

intro.en: Alto Piemonte Nebbiolo-led dry red.
intro.zh: Alto Piemonte 的 Nebbiolo 主导干红。

intro.en: Southeastern Piemonte white PDO made from Cortese.
intro.zh: Piemonte 东南部以 Cortese 酿造的白酒 PDO。

intro.en: Novara-side Alto Piemonte Nebbiolo PDO.
intro.zh: Novara 一侧的 Alto Piemonte Nebbiolo PDO。

intro.en: An inland Bari DOC spanning Primitivo, blended red/rosato, white and Aleatico categories.
intro.zh: Bari 内陆 DOC，涵盖 Primitivo、混酿红／桃红、白酒及 Aleatico。

intro.en: A small Ionian passito DOC around Bianco, based on an aromatic Malvasia identity.
intro.zh: Bianco 周围的小型爱奥尼亚海岸风干甜酒 DOC，以芳香型 Malvasia 身份葡萄为基础。

intro.en: Greco-led still and traditional-method sparkling DOCG in the Sabato valley of Irpinia.
intro.zh: Irpinia Sabato 河谷，以 Greco 为主的静止及传统法起泡 DOCG。

intro.en: Dry red DOC from the Asti hills, distinct from Grignolino del Monferrato Casalese.
intro.zh: Asti 丘陵干红 DOC，独立于 Grignolino del Monferrato Casalese。

intro.en: Island DOC off Naples, with distinctive Biancolella–Forastera white blends and local red varieties.
intro.zh: Napoli 外海岛屿 DOC，以 Biancolella—Forastera 白葡萄配比与地方红葡萄为特色。

intro.en: Aromatic red denomination near Ancona, based on Lacrima with rose and violet perfume.
intro.zh: Ancona 附近芳香红酒产区，以 Lacrima 为基础，具玫瑰紫罗兰香。

intro.en: Modena plain DOC producing especially pale, fragrant and acid-driven red and rosé Lambrusco.
intro.zh: Modena 平原 DOC，尤以色浅、芳香、酸度鲜明的红及桃红 Lambrusco 著称。

intro.en: Southern Modena foothill DOC known for deeply coloured, tannic Lambrusco.
intro.zh: Modena 南部山麓 DOC，以深色、有单宁 Lambrusco 著称。

name: Lambrusco Salamino di Santa Croce DOC

intro.en: Carpi-area plain DOC led by Lambrusco Salamino.
intro.zh: Carpi 周边平原、以 Lambrusco Salamino 为主的 DOC。

intro.en: Volcanic Castelli Romani whites, Cesanese from the eastern hills, Cori’s Bellone and Nero Buono, and Terracina’s aromatic wines form distinct regional traditions.
intro.zh: 火山 Castelli Romani 白酒、东部丘陵 Cesanese、Cori 的 Bellone 与 Nero Buono、Terracina 芳香酒构成不同地方传统。

intro.en: Coastal region linking western Rossese/Pigato wines to eastern Bosco–Albarola blends and cross-border Colli di Luni.
intro.zh: 沿海大区，连接西部 Rossese／Pigato 酒、东部 Bosco–Albarola 混酿及跨界 Colli di Luni。

intro.en: Northern region spanning Alpine Nebbiolo, Garda whites and rosés, Franciacorta and Oltrepò sparkling traditions.
intro.zh: 北部大区，涵盖阿尔卑斯 Nebbiolo、Garda 白酒桃红及 Franciacorta、Oltrepò 起泡传统。

intro.en: Southern Lake Garda white PDO shared by Lombardia and Veneto.
intro.zh: Garda 湖南部跨 Lombardia 与 Veneto 的白酒 PDO。

intro.en: The Aeolian aromatic wine DOC, combining Malvasia di Lipari with a small but compulsory Corinto Nero component.
intro.zh: Aeolian 群岛芳香酒 DOC，以 Malvasia di Lipari 加少量必需 Corinto Nero。

intro.en: An inland Sardinian blend DOC requiring Bovale Sardo, Cannonau and Monica.
intro.zh: Sardegna 内陆混酿 DOC，必须含 Bovale Sardo、Cannonau、Monica。

intro.en: Adriatic and Apennine influences define a region of Verdicchio, Pecorino and Passerina whites, aromatic Lacrima and Vernaccia Nera reds, and Montepulciano-led southern wines.
intro.zh: 亚得里亚海与亚平宁山共同塑造地区：白酒有 Verdicchio、Pecorino、Passerina；红酒有芳香 Lacrima、Vernaccia Nera 及南部 Montepulciano 主导酒款。

intro.en: A fortified-wine DOC classified by colour, sweetness and minimum ageing, governed here by the August 2026 consolidated text.
intro.zh: 加强酒 DOC，按颜色、甜度及最低陈年分类；本档案依 2026 年 8 月整合法规。

intro.en: Matera-province DOC with specified Sangiovese, Primitivo, Greco and international-variety blends across warmer southeastern Basilicata.
intro.zh: 涵盖 Basilicata 东南部较暖区域的 Matera 省 DOC，规范 Sangiovese、Primitivo、Greco 及国际品种配比。

intro.en: Broad Modena denomination with multiple wine types; the Lambrusco rules apply to its Lambrusco type.
intro.zh: Modena 广域多类型产区，Lambrusco 规则适用于其 Lambrusco 类型。

intro.en: Small Adriatic and inland region connecting Montepulciano and Aglianico blends with the recovered local Tintilia grape.
intro.zh: 兼有亚得里亚海岸与内陆的小型大区，连接 Montepulciano、Aglianico 混酿及保育地方 Tintilia。

intro.en: Historical wine district containing multiple independent DOCs and DOCGs.
intro.zh: 包含多个独立 DOC、DOCG 的历史葡萄酒地区。

intro.en: Broad Asti–Alessandria DOC producing white, rosé and red wines.
intro.zh: Asti–Alessandria 广域 DOC，生产白、桃红、红酒。

intro.en: A multi-style denomination encompassing Sangiovese-based reds and local white grapes, separate from Sagrantino DOCG.
intro.zh: 包含 Sangiovese 主导红酒及本土白葡萄多酒型产区，与 Sagrantino DOCG 独立。

intro.en: Dry and passito wines made exclusively from Sagrantino in a small Umbrian hill area.
intro.zh: 翁布里亚小片丘陵内仅用 Sagrantino 酿造的干型及风干甜型酒。

intro.en: Broad Abruzzo red-wine DOC based on Montepulciano, separate from the Tuscan town of that name.
intro.zh: 以 Montepulciano 为主的广域 Abruzzo 红酒 DOC，与 Tuscany 同名城镇分开。

intro.en: Concentrated sweet red dried-grape PDO.
intro.zh: 浓缩风干甜红 PDO。

intro.en: A dry, exclusively Barbera DOCG around Nizza Monferrato.
intro.zh: 围绕 Nizza Monferrato、完全使用 Barbera 的干红 DOCG。

intro.en: Southern Marche denomination with separate Pecorino, Passerina and Montepulciano-based Rosso types.
intro.zh: Marche 南部产区，分 Pecorino、Passerina 及 Montepulciano 主导 Rosso。

intro.en: Broad DOC within a district that also contains several independent DOC and DOCG names.
intro.zh: 较广 DOC 所在地区同时含多个独立 DOC 与 DOCG。

intro.en: White-wine denomination crossing the Umbria–Lazio border, with dry through noble-rot sweet expressions.
intro.zh: 跨 Umbria–Lazio 边界的白酒产区，风格从干型至贵腐甜型。

intro.en: Ovada or Dolcetto di Ovada Superiore DOCG; distinct from Dolcetto di Ovada DOC.
intro.zh: Ovada 或 Dolcetto di Ovada Superiore DOCG；与 Dolcetto di Ovada DOC 独立。

intro.en: An island DOC centred on Zibibbo, covering dry, sweet, sparkling and separately fortified categories.
intro.zh: 以 Zibibbo 为核心的海岛 DOC，涵盖干、甜、起泡及独立加强酒型。

intro.en: Isernia DOC with a modern Montepulciano–Tintilia red blend.
intro.zh: Isernia DOC，现代红酒以 Montepulciano—Tintilia 配比为核心。

intro.en: Northwestern region spanning Langhe, Roero, Monferrato, Alto Piemonte and Alpine foothill grape traditions.
intro.zh: 西北大区，涵盖 Langhe、Roero、Monferrato、Alto Piemonte 及阿尔卑斯山前葡萄传统。

intro.en: A Primitivo-led red DOC in Taranto and Brindisi, distinct from the sweet DOCG.
intro.zh: Taranto 与 Brindisi 的 Primitivo 主体红酒 DOC，与甜型 DOCG 分开。

name: Primitivo di Manduria Dolce Naturale DOCG

intro.en: A naturally sweet Primitivo DOCG with its own composition, sugar and release rules.
intro.zh: 自然甜型 Primitivo DOCG，具有独立比例、糖分与上市规则。

intro.en: Cross-regional Glera-led denomination spanning Veneto and Friuli-Venezia Giulia, with separately specified white and rosé styles.
intro.zh: 跨 Veneto、Friuli-Venezia Giulia 的 Glera 主导产区，白酒与桃红各有规范。

intro.en: Puglia combines Primitivo and Negroamaro country with Uva di Troia in the north and a diverse central white-grape tradition. Its principal names cover distinct legal styles rather than a single warm-climate red-wine model.
intro.zh: Puglia 除 Primitivo、Negroamaro 外，北部以 Uva di Troia 为重点，中部白葡萄传统多样；各主要名称代表不同法定酒型。

intro.en: Sweet Verduzzo Friulano DOCG on the southern slopes of Monte Bernadia around Nimis and Tarcento.
intro.zh: Nimis、Tarcento 周边 Monte Bernadia 南坡的甜型 Verduzzo Friulano DOCG。

intro.en: Sweet red DOCG made from dried grapes; a separate denomination from Amarone.
intro.zh: 以风干葡萄酿制的甜红 DOCG，与 Amarone 独立。

intro.en: Reggio Emilia DOC with Lambrusco, Ancellotta-led red and other separately specified types.
intro.zh: Reggio Emilia DOC，包含 Lambrusco、Ancellotta 主导红酒及其他独立规定类型。

intro.en: Western Ligurian multi-category PDO rather than one fixed blend.
intro.zh: Liguria 西部多类别 PDO，并非一种固定混酿。

intro.en: DOCG with Nebbiolo red and Arneis white categories.
intro.zh: 含 Nebbiolo 红酒及 Arneis 白酒类别的 DOCG。

intro.en: Romagna’s Albana-led white DOCG, spanning dry, sweet and passito expressions.
intro.zh: Romagna 以 Albana 为主的白酒 DOCG，涵盖干、甜及风干风格。

intro.en: Dry white blend DOCG centred on the Rosazzo hills and abbey in Udine province.
intro.zh: 以 Udine 省 Rosazzo 丘陵、修道院为中心的干白混酿 DOCG。

intro.en: Earlier-release Sangiovese from Montalcino, with its own DOC rules.
intro.zh: Montalcino 较早上市的 Sangiovese，具有独立 DOC 规则。

intro.en: Dry aromatic red DOCG in Astigiano Monferrato.
intro.zh: Astigiano Monferrato 芳香干红 DOCG。

intro.en: A Salento DOC led by Negroamaro, with revised composition and Superiore rules in May 2026.
intro.zh: 以 Negroamaro 为主的 Salento DOC，2026 年 5 月更新比例与 Superiore 规则。

intro.en: Sardegna combines the Vermentino of Gallura, Cannonau across the island, Carignano in Sulcis and long-aged Vernaccia around Oristano. Local synonyms require particular care: Bovale Sardo, Cagnulari and Bovale Grande are not interchangeable labels.
intro.zh: Sardegna 包括 Gallura 的 Vermentino、全岛 Cannonau、Sulcis 的 Carignano 及 Oristano 长期熟化 Vernaccia；Bovale Sardo、Cagnulari、Bovale Grande 不可随意互换。

intro.en: Dry red made from dried Nebbiolo grapes.
intro.zh: 风干 Nebbiolo 酿成的干红。

intro.en: Sicilia ranges from Etna’s volcanic vineyards and Vittoria’s red blends to western fortified wines and island passiti. Its indigenous grape collection includes both established varieties and recently recovered material.
intro.zh: Sicilia 从 Etna 火山葡萄园、Vittoria 红酒混酿，延伸至西部加强酒及离岛风干酒；本地葡萄既有成熟主流品种，也有近年恢复材料。

intro.en: Garganega-led white denomination east of Verona, including historical hills and a wider delimited zone.
intro.zh: Verona 东侧以 Garganega 为主的白酒产区，含历史丘陵及较广划定区域。

intro.en: Separate Garganega-led DOCG associated with the Soave hillside zone.
intro.zh: 与 Soave 丘陵区相连、以 Garganega 为主的独立 DOCG。

intro.en: Umbrian white-wine denomination focused on Trebbiano Spoletino, including still, sparkling and passito styles.
intro.zh: 以 Trebbiano Spoletino 为中心的翁布里亚白酒产区，包含静态、起泡与风干甜型。

intro.en: Inland Irpinia red-wine DOCG centred on late-ripening Aglianico, with substantial compulsory maturation.
intro.zh: Irpinia 内陆红酒 DOCG，以晚熟 Aglianico 为核心，要求较长法定熟成。

intro.en: Teroldego denomination of the Campo Rotaliano north of Trento.
intro.zh: Trento 北侧 Campo Rotaliano 的 Teroldego 法定产区。

intro.en: Southern Lazio denomination centred on the aromatic Moscato di Terracina grape.
intro.zh: Lazio 南部，以芳香葡萄 Moscato di Terracina 为核心。

intro.en: Caserta-centred geographical indication important for recovered Pallagrello and Casavecchia wines.
intro.zh: 以 Caserta 为核心的地理标志，Pallagrello、Casavecchia 保育酒款的重要载体。

intro.en: Interior Potenza valley DOC structured around Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, with a distinctive Malvasia contribution to rosé.
intro.zh: Potenza 内陆河谷 DOC，以 Merlot、Cabernet Sauvignon 为骨架，桃红特别要求 Malvasia 组成。

intro.en: Tintilia-focused DOC across specified hills in both Molise provinces.
intro.zh: 以 Tintilia 为核心，跨 Molise 两省指定丘陵的 DOC。

intro.en: Sangiovese-led inland hills and Cabernet-led coastal zones coexist with distinctive white grapes and a diverse local red patrimony.
intro.zh: 内陆 Sangiovese 丘陵与沿海 Cabernet 产区并存，另有独特白葡萄及丰富地方红葡萄。

intro.en: Still-white DOC allowing two different Trebbiano grapes as principals.
intro.zh: 允许两种不同 Trebbiano 作主品种的静止白酒 DOC。

intro.en: Wine territory of the autonomous province of Trento, encompassing several distinct DOCs.
intro.zh: Trento 自治省葡萄酒区域，含多个独立 DOC。

intro.en: Alpine administrative region comprising Trentino and Alto Adige/Südtirol, with distinct provincial wine territories.
intro.zh: 阿尔卑斯行政大区，由 Trentino 与 Alto Adige／Südtirol 构成，各有不同省级葡萄酒区域。

intro.en: Traditional-method sparkling denomination of Trentino; Trentodoc is its collective promotional identity.
intro.zh: Trentino 传统法起泡产区；Trentodoc 为其集体推广身份。

intro.en: Landlocked central Italy links Sagrantino’s tannic red wines, Sangiovese blends, late-ripening Trebbiano Spoletino and Orvieto’s white traditions.
intro.zh: 意大利中部内陆地区，连接 Sagrantino 高单宁红酒、Sangiovese 混酿、晚熟 Trebbiano Spoletino 及 Orvieto 白酒传统。

intro.en: Alpine valley with distinct local grapes and a regional DOC containing geographical and varietal identities.
intro.zh: 阿尔卑斯谷地，拥有独特地方葡萄及包含地理、品种身份的大区 DOC。

intro.en: Regional DOC with geographical and varietal wine categories, separate from the administrative region.
intro.zh: 含地理及品种酒类别的大区 DOC，与行政大区分开。

intro.en: Fresh-grape red DOC of Verona, separate from Ripasso and the two dried-grape DOCGs.
intro.zh: Verona 鲜葡萄红酒 DOC，与 Ripasso 及两个风干 DOCG 分开。

intro.en: Valpolicella red re-fermented on Amarone or Recioto marc under a separate DOC.
intro.zh: Valpolicella 红酒在 Amarone 或 Recioto 酒渣上再发酵，属独立 DOC。

intro.en: Alpine wine district containing independent protected red-wine denominations.
intro.zh: 含独立受保护红酒名称的阿尔卑斯葡萄酒地区。

intro.en: Nebbiolo-led Alpine dry-red PDO with five named subzones.
intro.zh: Nebbiolo 主导、有五个具名分区的阿尔卑斯干红 PDO。

name: Riviera del Garda Classico DOC · Valtènesi

intro.en: Valtènesi is a specified subzone within Riviera del Garda Classico DOC.
intro.zh: Valtènesi 为 Riviera del Garda Classico DOC 内指定分区。

intro.en: Northeastern Italian region joining Garda, Verona, Vicenza and Treviso wine territories.
intro.zh: 意大利东北大区，连接 Garda、Verona、Vicenza 与 Treviso 葡萄酒区域。

intro.en: Verdicchio from the Esino hill system, extending from maritime-influenced slopes toward the pre-Apennines.
intro.zh: Esino 丘陵体系的 Verdicchio，从受海洋影响的坡地延向亚平宁山麓。

intro.en: Inland Verdicchio from a north–south valley sheltered from Adriatic moderation by Monte San Vicino.
intro.zh: 内陆南北向谷地的 Verdicchio，Monte San Vicino 阻挡亚得里亚海调节。

intro.en: Small Langhe dry-red PDO based on Pelaverga Piccolo.
intro.zh: 以 Pelaverga Piccolo 为基础的小型 Langhe 干红 PDO。

intro.en: A northeastern Sardinian DOCG tied to granitic soils and Vermentino, with still and specialised wine categories.
intro.zh: Sardegna 东北部 DOCG，以花岗岩土壤与 Vermentino 为核心，兼静止及其他酒型。

intro.en: A western Sardinian DOC for mature Vernaccia wines, with flor ageing a defining producer reference.
intro.zh: Sardegna 西部陈年 Vernaccia DOC，酒花膜熟化为重要生产者参照。

intro.en: Dry white from the San Gimignano hills, built on the local Vernaccia grape and Pliocene sediments.
intro.zh: San Gimignano 丘陵干白，以当地 Vernaccia 葡萄及上新世沉积土为基础。

intro.en: Somma–Vesuvius DOC with Lacryma Christi styles and expanded varietal categories under the 2025 specification.
intro.zh: Somma–Vesuvius DOC，含 Lacryma Christi 风格及 2025 规范扩展的品种类别。

intro.en: Sangiovese-based red from the Tuscan town of Montepulciano; the town name is distinct from the Montepulciano grape.
intro.zh: 托斯卡纳 Montepulciano 城镇的 Sangiovese 主导红酒，地名不同于 Montepulciano 葡萄。

intro.en: Rully is the northern Côte Chalonnaise village appellation spanning Rully and Chagny. It produces still Chardonnay-led whites and Pinot Noir-led reds at Village and Premier Cru levels; its 23 Premier Cru climats form the core of this connected reference.
intro.zh: Rully 位于 Côte Chalonnaise 北部，跨 Rully 与 Chagny 两市镇。静态白葡萄酒以 Chardonnay 为主，红葡萄酒以 Pinot Noir 为主；分 Village 与 Premier Cru。本专题逐一关联其 23 个 Premier Cru climat、生产者与酒款。
